title: Canonical tensor cocones for arbitrary transported stage diagrams
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, F:I→CommRingCat a diagram with colimit A, i₀≤i, B₀ and C₀ commutative F(i₀)-algebras, and P,Q commutative rings with Q a P-algebra. Put B_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀, C_j=F(j)⊗_{F(i₀)}C₀, B=A⊗_{F(i₀)}B₀ and C=A⊗_{F(i₀)}C₀. Let J={j | i≤j}. Give B a P-algebra structure, and fix P-algebra structures on each B_j. Suppose D,E:J→CommRingCat are common-universe diagrams with ring equivalences d_j:D_j≃B_j⊗_P Q and c_j:E_j≃C_j. Suppose P-algebra maps μ_j:B_j→B equal the canonical tensor maps; source transitions correspond under d to β_jk⊗id_Q for P-linear canonical tensor transitions β_jk; and target transitions correspond under c to canonical tensor maps C_j→C_k. Then D and E admit cocones cD,cE with ring equivalences dLim:cD.pt≃B⊗_P Q and cLim:cE.pt≃C, whose source legs correspond to μ_j⊗id_Q and target legs to the canonical C_j→C tensor maps. No comparison transformation, ψ, pushout condition, or colimit assertion is assumed or concluded.

proof.text: Define source ring-hom legs gD_j=(μ_j⊗id_Q)∘d_j and target legs gE_j=(canonical C_j→C)∘c_j. To prove naturality, use the transition hypotheses and tensor-map composition; colimit.w identifies the composites of canonical scalar maps. Tensor induction verifies the ring-hom equalities and P-algebra-map extensionality verifies μ_k∘β_jk=μ_j.

Choose the cocone points as ULifts of B⊗_P Q and C. Compose gD and gE with the inverse down ring equivalences. The naturality just proved yields cocones; applying down after up proves the required leg identities.

theorem exists_comparison_tensor_canonical_cocones
    {I : Type v} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (F : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{v}) [HasColimit F]
    (i₀ : I) (B₀ : Type w) (C₀ : Type x) [CommRing B₀] [CommRing C₀]
    [Algebra (F.obj i₀) B₀] [Algebra (F.obj i₀) C₀]
    (P Q : Type y) [CommRing P] [CommRing Q] [Algebra P Q]
    (aP : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra P (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (i : I) (hi : i₀ ≤ i)
    (aPs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
          letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
          Algebra P (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
        (D E : {j : I // i ≤ j} ⥤ CommRingCat.{max v w x y})
    (d : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
              letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
              letI := aPs j
              ↥(D.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q)
    (c : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
                letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                ↥(E.obj j) ≃+* (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀))
    (μs : ∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                      (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀))
    (hμs : (∀ j : {j : I // i ≤ j},
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    (μs j).toRingHom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom))
    (hDt : (∀ {j k : {j : I // i ≤ j}} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aPs k
                    ∃ β : (↥(F.obj j.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) →ₐ[P]
                        (↥(F.obj k.val) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀),
                      (let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm };
                        β.toRingHom =
                          (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk
                            (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) B₀)).toRingHom) ∧
                      (d k).toRingHom.comp (D.map r).hom =
                        (Algebra.TensorProduct.map β (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                          (d j).toRingHom))
    (hEt : (∀ {j k : {j : I // i ≤ j}} (r : j ⟶ k),
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans k.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αjk : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] F.obj k.val :=
                        { (F.map (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).hom with
                          commutes' := fun s ↦
                            congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ F.obj k.val ↦ f s)
                              (F.map_comp (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))
                                (homOfLE (leOfHom r))).symm }
                    (c k).toRingHom.comp (E.map r).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αjk (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom)) :
      let J := {j : I // i ≤ j}
              ∃ (cD : Cocone D) (cE : Cocone E),
                ∃ (dLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aP
                    ↥cD.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] B₀) ⊗[P] Q)
                  (cLim : letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    ↥cE.pt ≃+* (↥(colimit F) ⊗[F.obj i₀] C₀)),
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := aPs j
                    letI := aP
                    dLim.toRingHom.comp (cD.ι.app j).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map (μs j) (AlgHom.id P Q)).toRingHom.comp
                        (d j).toRingHom) ∧
                  (∀ j : J,
                    letI := (colimit.ι F i₀).hom.toAlgebra
                    letI := (F.map (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))).hom.toAlgebra
                    let αj : F.obj j.val →ₐ[F.obj i₀] ↥(colimit F) :=
                      { (colimit.ι F j.val).hom with
                        commutes' := fun s ↦
                          congrArg (fun f : F.obj i₀ ⟶ colimit F ↦ f s)
                            (colimit.w F (homOfLE (hi.trans j.property))) }
                    cLim.toRingHom.comp (cE.ι.app j).hom =
                      (Algebra.TensorProduct.map αj (AlgHom.id (F.obj i₀) C₀)).toRingHom.comp
                        (c j).toRingHom)
